newsitem.title: TURKEY: Seven Turk soldiers injured in land-mine blast.
newsitem.headline: Seven Turk soldiers injured in land-mine blast.

text.p: Seven Turkish soldiers were injured on Tuesday when their jeep struck a land-mine in southeast Turkey, security officials told Reuters.
They said the army four-wheel drive vehicle hit a mine near the village of Narlikoy in Diyarbakir province early on Tuesday. It was unclear who planted the mine.

More than 26,000 people have died in the 13-year old conflict between the Turkish armed forces and rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party who are fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
